scope: Heuristics microsecond interval ordering, ordinary waits, public epoch-float sojourns, business-prefix arithmetic and exact mean aggregation.

validation.mean_goldens: public Python statistics.mean fixed-bit tests including signed cancellation, overflow, subnormal and normal ties

limits: Finite EventLog observations across microsecond waits/sojourns, business schedules, negative epochs, timezone offsets and year9999.
Exact numeric comparisons; named accepted edges are sorted only to disregard presentation order.
ISO-string XES preserves constructed datetime clock fields and offsets; typed-date import normalization is separate.
Ordinary PLUSPLUS sojourns intentionally retain public timestamp-float subtraction behavior, which can lose microseconds at large years.
No full object parity or structural coverage upgrade is claimed.
